data.display_address: Sunrise Living at Jumeirah Park, Jumeirah Park, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience luxury living in this stunning brand-new 5-bedroom villa located in the prestigious Sunrise Living community of Jumeirah Park. Boasting a prime lake-facing position, this exceptional home offers a serene environment combined with modern architectural elegance.

The villa features five spacious ensuite bedrooms, six beautifully designed bathrooms, and expansive open-plan living and dining areas filled with natural light. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide seamless indoor-outdoor living, overlooking a private landscaped garden and swimming pool.

Designed for comfort and functionality, the property also includes a fully equipped modern kitchen, maid’s room, ample storage space, and a covered double garage. The rooftop terrace offers additional space perfect for relaxation or entertaining while enjoying scenic lake views.

Ready for immediate occupancy, this vacant villa is ideal for families seeking a premium lifestyle in a quiet, well-connected community.

Key Features:

5 Bedrooms | 6 Bathrooms
Brand New & Vacant
Prime Lake View Location
Private Pool & Garden
Rooftop Terrace
Modern Finishes Throughout
Gated, Family-Friendly Community

A perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and tranquility—this is a rare opportunity to own a premium home in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods.
